from yolobit import *
button_a.on_pressed = None
button_b.on_pressed = None
button_a.on_pressed_ab = button_b.on_pressed_ab = -1
from mqtt import *
from aiot_lcd1602 import LCD1602
from machine import Pin, SoftI2C
from aiot_dht20 import DHT20
from aiot_rgbled import RGBLed
import time

aiot_lcd1602 = LCD1602()

aiot_dht20 = DHT20()

def on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_FAN_(fan):
  global temp, humi, bright, lumi, lcd
  pin1.write_analog(round(translate((int(fan)), 0, 100, 0, 1023)))

tiny_rgb = RGBLed(pin0.pin, 4)

def on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_RGB_(lumi):
  global temp, humi, bright, fan, lcd
  if lumi == '0':
    tiny_rgb.show(0, hex_to_rgb('#000000'))
  if lumi == '1':
    tiny_rgb.show(0, hex_to_rgb('#ffa500'))
  if lumi == '2':
    tiny_rgb.show(0, hex_to_rgb('#ffffff'))

def on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_LCD_(lcd):
  global temp, humi, bright, fan, lumi
  aiot_lcd1602.clear()
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 0)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr(lcd)

if True:
  display.scroll('hello')
  mqtt.connect_wifi('H6-601', 'CSE.HCMUT-H6.601')
  mqtt.connect_broker(server='io.adafruit.com', port=1883, username='w7thm', password='aio_RsOh51gGEAZtkkgzdTwN5PjRENnb')
  display.scroll('OK')
  aiot_lcd1602.clear()
  fan = '0'
  lumi = '0'

while True:
  aiot_dht20.read_dht20()
  temp = int((aiot_dht20.dht20_temperature()))
  humi = int((aiot_dht20.dht20_humidity()))
  bright = int((round(translate((pin2.read_analog()), 0, 4095, 0, 100))))
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 0)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr('Temp')
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(5, 0)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr('Humi')
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(10, 0)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr('Brig')
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(0, 1)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr((aiot_dht20.dht20_temperature()))
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(5, 1)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr((aiot_dht20.dht20_humidity()))
  aiot_lcd1602.move_to(10, 1)
  aiot_lcd1602.putstr((round(translate((pin2.read_analog()), 0, 4095, 0, 100))))
  mqtt.on_receive_message('DA_FAN', on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_FAN_)
  mqtt.on_receive_message('DA_RGB', on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_RGB_)
  mqtt.on_receive_message('DA_LCD', on_mqtt_message_receive_callback__DA_LCD_)
  mqtt.publish('DA_TEMP', (aiot_dht20.dht20_temperature()))
  mqtt.publish('DA_HUMI', (aiot_dht20.dht20_humidity()))
  mqtt.publish('DA_BRIG', (round(translate((pin2.read_analog()), 0, 4095, 0, 100))))
  time.sleep_ms(10000)
  time.sleep_ms(10)
